name: @revoap/frontend
description: Build tooling for the RevoAp console. Tailwind CSS and the vendored front-end libraries are compiled/vendored at build time; the RESULTS are committed under assets/dist and assets/vendor so a deployment never needs Node, npm or network access.

scripts.watch: node tools/build-css.mjs --dev && echo 'run node tools/build-css.mjs again after editing ui/*.css'
